title: Payments warns about a growing cache
query: Payments is logging warnings about a cache getting bigger. No customer errors yet but memory has climbed all morning.
root_cause: Payments keeps an in-memory cache that grows with every request and is never freed.

remediation.detail: Restart payments to reclaim memory, then bound the cache.

evidence: Payments WARNING receipt cache size entries show increasing approx_mb
query_paraphrase: Payments has started warning that some store of receipts is getting large. Customers are fine so far, but its memory has been rising since the morning.
